QuestInfo.name: [Detective Rave's Case Notes] Order Overload
QuestInfo.0: Gusto in the #bBlack Market#k gave the excuse that they have too many orders to fill. Talk to Gusto again.
QuestInfo.1: You need to hunt Dangerous Nutria monsters in #bSketchy Back-Alley 3#k and bring back #bScratched Cast Iron Plate#k items.
QuestInfo.2: Gusto was wondering what it was for, but gave you the steel plate anyway. Afterwards, you headed back to the Luxury Tour Agency with Rave.

default.0: You said you'd get #bScratched Cast Iron Plates#k from #bSketchy Back-Alley 3#k. You haven't changed your mind, right?
